Attach self-attested copies of all required documents, scanned and arranged in sequence as per the checklist, in PDF format only.

Submit a separate application for each post applied for; only one form should be filled per candidate for each applied post.
Ensure the application reaches the office by 9 August 2026.
Note: This recruitment does not use an online application portal - applications are accepted only by email, Speed Post, or hand delivery, in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications submitted after the last date will not be entertained. The exact interview date, along with the list of candidates and departments, will be published on www.esic.gov.in/recruitments or emailed directly to candidates after scrutiny of documents, following the closing date.

rows.date: Third week of August 2026 (11 or 12 August 2026)

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ESIC has notified a total of 85 posts across 25 departments: 7 Professor, 20 Associate Professor, 19 Assistant Professor, and 39 Senior Resident posts. The department-wise and category-wise vacancy position is given below. These vacancies include reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwD) and Ex-Servicemen as per prevailing Government of India norms; if candidates in these categories are unavailable, vacancies will be filled from the interview panel to meet essential service and NMC norm requirements, and the PwD reservation will be carried forward. Vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per actual requirement. In case of non-availability of reserved category candidates, a post may be filled for less than 45 days as a de-reserved seat.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Age relaxation will be given as per the prevailing norms of the Government of India. The maximum tenure of the contractual engagement, in any case, is till the candidate attains 70 years of age, subject to fulfilment of other rules. EWS candidates must submit the EWS Certificate as per Annexure-I of DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt(Res), dated 31 January 2019, based on F.Y. 2025-26 and issued on or after 1 April 2026. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates must submit the OBC (NCL) Certificate as per Annexure-I of DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res.), dated 30 May 2014, and subsequent amendments.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made on the basis of the candidate's acquired academic credentials and their performance in an interview before the Selection Board - there is no separate written examination for these posts. The result will be displayed in the Recruitment section of www.esic.gov.in/recruitments, and the offer of appointment will be sent only through email. All candidates must report for document verification at the interview venue at 9:00 AM on the scheduled date. Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to an interview unless the candidate reports with the required documents on the scheduled date and time.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Required Documents
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must be attached with the application, and originals will be verified at the time of interview and joining: Class-X mark sheet/certificate (for date of birth) All mark sheets, attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MBBS All mark sheets, attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/other qualifying examination Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD Certificate in the Central Government job format, wherever applicable Recent passport-size photograph Updated State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate Proof of publication(s) Experience certificate(s) Completion Certificate of ICMR/NMC-conducted Bio-medical Research examination, if any NMC Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop Completion Certificate, if any Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current employer, if applicable Aadhaar Card and PAN Card Demand Draft, if applicable (application fee)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Note: This recruitment does not use an online application portal - applications are accepted only by email, Speed Post, or hand delivery, in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ranchi Faculty Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year, extendable annually up to a maximum of 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance, or till a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Leave: 2.5 days of paid Earned Leave for each completed month of work, pro-rata, credited after completion of the working month; no half-pay leave, advance leave, or leave encashment. Termination/Resignation: Either side may terminate with one month's prior notice; spot resignation requires depositing one month's salary into the ESI account. Security Deposit: Rs. 30,000 (non-interest bearing) as a Demand Draft in favour of "ESIC Saving Fund Account No. 2", payable at Namkum, at the time of joining - refundable after successful completion of the contract with a "No Dues Certificate". Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited, and simultaneous teaching engagement at another hospital/medical college is not permitted. No accommodation is provided; attendance must be marked manually as well as on the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS). Absence beyond 7 days without proper permission is treated as voluntary abandonment and results in automatic termination.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 05 of 2026 by ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi, for 85 contractual posts of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident across 25 departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 85 vacancies: 7 Professor, 20 Associate Professor, 19 Assistant Professor, and 39 Senior Resident posts across 25 departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office by 9 August 2026; applications received after this date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Educational qualification is as per National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines dated 30 June 2025, requiring MBBS plus the relevant postgraduate/super-specialty qualification and updated Medical Registration for the applied post and department.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor: not exceeding 69 years. Senior Resident: 45 years (50 years for Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine, and Community Medicine departments), as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500 via Demand Draft for candidates other than SC/ST/Female/Ex-Servicemen/PH, who are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for ESIC Ranchi Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor: Rs. 1,23,100; Associate Professor: Rs. 78,800; Assistant Professor and Senior Resident: Rs. 67,700 - all as consolidated remuneration under the 7th CPC pay levels, plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance before a Selection Board; there is no written examination.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill the prescribed application format and submit it, preferably by email to [email protected], or via Speed Post/by hand, along with self-attested documents and the application fee, by 9 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is ESIC Ranchi Faculty Recruitment 2026 a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. This is a contractual engagement for 1 year, extendable annually up to a maximum of 3 years or until a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier, with no claim to service regularisation.
